theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank #2 with the strongest combination of high durability (0.79), full breadth (1.0), and trend-favorable eligibility — the validated risk-control leg. It is not crowded and shows one of the cleanest momentum-plus-staying-power profiles among eligible names. Lean is a directional trend continuation, not a momentum-return claim.
theses.dissent: Silver is a speculative metal with rapid beta to rate/haven narratives; breadth of 1.0 can mean herding into a single crowded metal trade rather than durable leadership, and the momentum rank itself has near-zero forward IC.

falsifier.text: SIL lags GDX by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date
